options.label: Raise a stat
options.text: Raise one stat by 1, up to your Year cap: +2 in Years 1-3, +3 in Years 4-6, +4 in Year 7.

options.label: Learn a spell
options.text: Learn one spell you do not already know. Forbidden spells are never learned this way.

options.label: Take a new subject
options.text: Take a subject you have not studied before. You gain its +1 and may learn its magic.

options.label: Learn a talent
options.text: Learn a new talent from your playbook or another.
